name: Onboarding
job: Onboard SOLD new members. Tags v2_status_active, sends welcome SMS after SOLD, short 3d and 7d check-in SMS (logistics only), then forks to WF-10 at T+14 and WF-14 at T+21.

trigger.notes: Sole enroll path is ADD-TO-WF from WF-05. Renewals never enter WF-06 (they go to WF-09). Check-in SMS between waits are logistics only (no symptom / treatment talk).
